_comment: Hand-maintained mapping: curated search area -> polygon used to scope and parent OSM streets/hoods. 'osm' lists OSM relation/way ids (r.../w...) from the Geofabrik extract, unioned. 'derive' builds a circle (metres) around an OSM node (n...) or the curated centroid when OSM has no polygon. 'clip' intersects with other OSM polygons. 'buffer_m' widens sector polygons whose borders run along street centrelines. Smallest polygon wins where they overlap. Every entry is listed in REVIEW.md with its area and provenance.

area:ras-beirut.note: Cadastral quartier Ras Beirut (admin_level 7); Hamra and Verdun carve out first

area:verdun.note: No OSM polygon; 600 m circle around the OSM Verdun node, inside Beirut governorate

area:jnah.note: No OSM polygon or node; 700 m circle around the curated centroid, inside Beirut governorate

area:badaro.note: No OSM polygon; 500 m circle around the OSM Badaro node, inside Beirut governorate

area:jounieh.note: No OSM polygon found for Jounieh; 2.5 km circle around the curated centroid, now moved to the coastal town centre (OSM Jounieh Municipality w-way at 33.9848,35.6340; AUL Jounieh campus is 350 m away). Kaslik/Sarba carves out first

area:kaslik.note: OSM municipality Sarba, which contains the curated Kaslik centroid

area:bhamdoun.note: No OSM polygon for Bhamdoun itself; 1.2 km circle around the curated centroid

area:zahle.note: No OSM polygon found for Zahle; 2 km circle around the curated centroid
